evals.expected_output: Natural-language template update in a generated IINA plugin repo: run scripts/answers_lineage.py first; only after ok=true proceed with Copier 9.18.2 via pnpm run template:update or uvx copier update pinned to the named immutable tag/SHA. Agent requires lineage ok=true and a named immutable tag or SHA before mutating.

evals.expected_output: Does not fire iina-upgrade as a generator. New trees from a Copier source (git URL or ZIP) belong to iina-generate (user-installed only). This skill does not generate a new tree.
assertions: Agent does not treat iina-upgrade as the path to create a new plugin tree.
Agent does not run Copier copy, invent a Copier source, or write a new project scaffold.
Agent states that generating from a Copier source is iina-generate (user-installed only).

evals.expected_output: Refuses missing or fixture .copier-answers.yml (answers_lineage.py ok=false) and refuses --trust/--UNSAFE when lineage unsafe is false. Does not run copier update or template:update under those conditions.
assertions: Agent refuses when .copier-answers.yml is missing or lineage reports ok=false.
Agent refuses fixture _src_path / tests/fixtures answers rather than updating.
Agent refuses --trust and --UNSAFE when lineage unsafe is false.
Agent does not run copier update or pnpm run template:update after those refusals.
